name: forgejo
title: Forgejo
description: Self-hosted Git service with a web interface, pull requests, issues, packages and CI runners (a community fork of Gitea). It keeps everything in one data folder with a built-in SQLite database. After deploying, open it, confirm the install page, and register: the first account becomes the administrator.

variables.name: PORT_FORGEJO
variables.label: Web UI Port
variables.description: Port to expose the Forgejo web interface on

variables.name: PORT_FORGEJO_SSH
variables.label: SSH Port
variables.description: Port on this server for Git over SSH; it is also the port shown in SSH clone URLs

variables.name: FORGEJO_ROOT_URL
variables.label: Public address
variables.description: The address people open, like https://git.example.com. Clone URLs and links in mails are built from it. Leave empty and DCS uses this deploy's route, or this server's address and the port above

auth_note: Not put behind Authelia: git clients, CI runners and the API sign in directly (the deploy sheet can still protect it)
